scenarios.title: Public property discovery
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}. Click 'Explore properties' in the top navigation and verify the heading 'Find your place.' is visible and the result count shows 'PROPERTIES'. Click the 'Buy' tab in the listing toolbar and verify at least one property card with a price in Naira (₦) is shown. Click 'View details' on the first card and verify a dialog opens showing a disclaimer that tells the visitor to independently confirm documents or not to send money.
scenarios.summary:
You asked to explore the property listings, switch to properties for sale, and open the first listing’s details.
Opened the property directory, where the “Find your place.” heading and a result count of 4 properties were shown.
Selected the Buy tab and confirmed listings with prices in Nigerian naira were displayed.
Opened the first property’s details, which displayed a safety disclaimer advising visitors to independently confirm documents or not send money.
Completed the requested property-browsing steps successfully.

scenarios.title: Login, protected routes and logout
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}/app without signing in and verify the page redirects to the sign-in form titled 'Welcome back'. Sign in with email {{buyer_email}} and password {{buyer_password}} and verify the dashboard Overview is visible. Reload the page and verify the dashboard is still visible. Click 'Sign out' and verify the home page with the GidaLink navigation is visible.

scenarios.title: Buyer permissions are enforced
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{buyer_email}} and password {{buyer_password}}. Verify the sidebar does not contain 'My listings', 'Verification queue' or 'Admin'. Open {{base_url}}/app/review and verify the page says 'You do not have access to this page'. Open {{base_url}}/app/admin and verify the same message. Open {{base_url}}/app/listings/new and verify the page does not show the 'List your property.' form.
scenarios.summary:
The test opened the admin page rather than the new-listing page specified in the objective. The account was a buyer and correctly saw an access message for that unrelated admin area.
Correct the navigation target to /app/listings/new, wait for that page to finish loading, and assert that “List your property.” is not visible there.
